text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a brilliant victory in the Satsuki 
Sho, Matikanetannhauser shows fierce 
enthusiasm for the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower, too, hid 
their frustration as they vowed to grow 
even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, each along their own path, the 
three strode forward, aiming for victory 
in the upcoming Japanese Derby.
